title: Observe approval on a trusted continuation
objective: Reuse request_approval for read-only status observation; no sixth status tool.
compliance: A user request alone is not a trusted resume or a grant. Runtime must bind the source, actor, revision, amount/currency, supplier, level, active policy and validity/revocation rules. A PENDING observation would leave the workflow waiting; DENIED/CANCELLED would halt. This authored APPROVED fixture can support readiness only under the stated conditional gate.
gate: Observation semantics confirmed under OD-APP-OBS-01. Execution remains conditional: read-only adapter verification, approval validity and trusted continuation remain pending.
